juce::AudioFormat Class Referenceabstract

## Detailed Description

Subclasses of [AudioFormat](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioFormat.html "Subclasses of AudioFormat are used to read and write different audio file formats.") are used to read and write different audio file formats.

See also[AudioFormatReader](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioFormatReader.html "Reads samples from an audio file stream."), [AudioFormatWriter](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioFormatWriter.html "Writes samples to an audio file stream."), [WavAudioFormat](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1WavAudioFormat.html "Reads and Writes WAV format audio files."), [AiffAudioFormat](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AiffAudioFormat.html "Reads and Writes AIFF format audio files.")

Returns true if this the given file can be read by this format.

Subclasses shouldn't do too much work here, just check the extension or file type. The base class implementation just checks the file's extension against one of the ones that was registered in the constructor.

Reimplemented in [juce::AiffAudioFormat](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AiffAudioFormat.html#a79c88302a5f59833d88085a34fba8c7a), and [juce::LAMEEncoderAudioFormat](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1LAMEEncoderAudioFormat.html#a0ba75af3307e0ca7254be9020974f6ff).
